market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $55,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC currently ~$76,500 on Apr 28-29, 2026. Resolution window opened Nov 24, 2025; the YTD low so far was ~$60K in Feb 2026, meaning this has not yet resolved. With 8 months remaining to Dec 31 and BTC already 39% off the Oct/Nov 2025 peak of ~$126K, another 28% slide from the current low to $55K would be a notable but not extreme move given crypto volatility. Slight discount vs the implied 0.50 since macro is mixed but not clearly bearish.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether macro/Iran-related risk-off triggers another leg lower or BTC bottoms here
